why_it_works: This ad uses an extremely bold, taboo-breaking headline that stops scrolling through pure shock value. By directly addressing a bodily function most people avoid discussing, it creates instant attention. The ad then legitimizes this crude hook with scientific-looking benefit points and impressive social proof (55,000+ reviews), shifting from shock to credibility. It targets a specific pain point (digestive issues on GLP-1 medications) that the audience is actively experiencing but may be embarrassed to discuss.
visual_elements: Large black bold sans-serif headline text, light mint green background, green gummy bear shape in center-right, green horizontal bars with white text containing benefits, small white icons next to each benefit point (digestive system, molecular structure, fruits/vegetables, bacteria, brain, no sugar symbol), yellow badge at bottom with 5 green stars, rounded corners on benefit bars
composition: Vertical layout with headline at top spanning full width, product image center-right taking up about 40% of vertical space, benefit list on left side aligned with product, review badge centered at bottom. Approximately 1:1 aspect ratio
angle: Shock value + mechanism education - uses crude humor to grab attention then educates on the solution's benefits and ingredients
audience: People taking GLP-1 medications (Ozempic, Wegovy) experiencing digestive side effects, likely 30-60 years old, health-conscious but struggling with medication side effects, problem-aware and actively seeking solutions

product_presence.description: Large green gummy bear shaped supplement, glossy texture suggesting fruit flavor
